name: Tamil Nadu Telecommunications Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1988, Tamil Nadu Tele communications Limited manufactures Optical Fiber Cables for Telecommunications.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is a three way joint venture of      
Telecommunications Consultants India Ltd (TCIL), a Government of India Enterprise under Ministry of Communications, Tamilnadu Industrial and Development Corporation Limited (TIDCO), a Govt. of Tamilnadu Enterprise, and Fujikura Limited of Japan, a manufacturer of Optical Fiber Products

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
